channel.title: Crypto Daybook
channel.description: Crypto Daybook reports daily crypto news: market moves, Bitcoin and Ethereum updates, exchange and protocol developments, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: Schroders brings emerging-markets bond fund to Solana
item.description: Schroders and Centrifuge have put an emerging-markets bond strategy on Solana, giving investors tokenized feeder-fund shares tied to debt across developing economies.

item.title: Liquid Network restores bitcoin backing after $320 million exploit
item.description: The Liquid Federation says every LBTC is backed one-for-one again after Blockstream supplied bitcoin left missing by a September exploit, though peg-out limits may remain.

item.title: Mercado Bitcoin will cover losses after $40M breach
item.description: Mercado Bitcoin says it will absorb about $38 million in losses after a breach, while partners have frozen funds and deposits and withdrawals remain paused.

item.title: Binance reopens more withdrawals after $6.3 billion breach
item.description: Binance has reopened withdrawals for some tokens after a $6.3 billion theft, while it expands access in phases and continues recovery and security checks for users.

item.title: OCC urges community banks to explore stablecoin issuance
item.description: The OCC is urging community banks to consider issuing dollar-linked stablecoins through subsidiaries, giving smaller lenders a path into payments under new federal rules.

item.title: Tether’s Bitcoin reserves valued at $8.37B in Q3 report
item.description: Tether’s Q3 report values its Bitcoin at $8.37 billion, up from $5.8 billion in June, giving USDT holders a snapshot of assets backing the token.

item.title: Binance says hot-wallet hack cost about $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance says attackers took about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets, and it plans phased withdrawals as it replenishes assets and traces the stolen funds.

item.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of assets stolen in $6.3B hack
item.description: Binance says it has replaced 90% of assets stolen in a $6.3 billion hack and aims to restore withdrawals Sunday, while its investigation continues.

item.title: Stable or volatile pool? Match the curve to the tokens
item.description: Stable pools can cut trading costs for assets that should stay near the same price, while volatile pools suit tokens that may move apart. Choose by the pair.

item.title: Binance says it will cover $6.3 billion stolen in wallet breach
item.description: Binance says attackers stole about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets and it will cover the loss, while investigators have frozen about $3 billion in funds so far.

item.title: Binance puts security incident impact at $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance says a security incident affected about $6.3 billion, with $3 billion frozen so far; withdrawals remain paused as the exchange investigates the breach.

item.title: Fermi Swap’s Inventory Sets the Limit on Large Orders
item.description: Fermi Swap fills trades from its own token stock, so large orders depend on available inventory, the quote and what remains when a transaction executes on chain.

item.title: Ripple gets final OCC approval for national trust bank
item.description: Ripple has final OCC approval for a national trust bank to manage RLUSD reserves and offer custody, bringing federal oversight while its New York unit remains the issuer.

item.title: Ripple wins final U.S. approval for national trust bank
item.description: Ripple has won final OCC approval for a national trust bank, adding federal oversight to RLUSD reserves and custody while issuance stays with its New York unit.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin rewards open to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC's GENIUS Act rule bars issuers from paying yield solely for holding stablecoins, while leaving exchange rewards subject to case-by-case review.

item.title: OCC leaves room for crypto platform stablecoin rewards
item.description: The OCC finalized its GENIUS Act rule without a blanket ban on platform rewards, leaving some stablecoin programs for case-by-case review from January 2027.

item.title: Tether lines up 15 mining groups for shared software
item.description: Tether says 15 mining firms, hardware makers and pools will build connections for its Mining Development Kit, a shared layer aimed at simpler mining automation.

item.title: OCC leaves some stablecoin rewards open for crypto platforms
item.description: The OCC's new GENIUS Act rule bars issuers from paying stablecoin interest directly, but leaves third-party rewards to case-by-case review by regulators.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana activated Anza’s Alpenglow upgrade on Oct. 21, moving validator votes off-chain and aiming to let payments reach finality in about 150 milliseconds.

item.title: Why zerofi Uses Its Assets and Token Differently
item.description: ZeroFi separates XMR-backed zXMR from ZFI, the token used for staking and governance, because each serves a different role in the bridge and its network.
